data.gender_notes: Chandrakant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chandrakant is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'kant' meaning adorned. This name signifies one who is adorned with the moon or the one who is the embodiment of the moon's cool and calming energy. It is also believed to bring prosperity and good fortune. The name Chandrakant carries the meaning “Moon adorned” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandrakant usually hope their child will grow to embody moon adorned and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of the cool and calming energy of the moon.
data.etymology: Chandrakant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon adorned.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrakant total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Chandrakant' carries a rich cultural significance in Hindu tradition. It honors the divine power of the moon, one of the most revered celestial bodies in Hindu mythology. The moon is often depicted as a symbol of change, mystery, and fertility, reflecting the cycles of life, the rise and fall of tides, and the waxing and waning of emotions. Naming a child as Chandrakant is a way to connect them to this powerful and enduring symbol of the Divine, and to infuse them with the traits associated with the moon such as cool-headedness, adaptability, and deep introspection.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name 'Chandrakant' is believed to bring the blessings of the moon god, Soma or Chandra, into a person's life. The moon is a powerful symbol of the Subtle Body, and it represents the mind and emotions. A person with the name Chandrakant is said to possess a calm and balanced mind, and the ability to navigate through life's challenges with grace and poise. They are believed to have a deep inner wisdom and intuition, and a natural ability to connect with the subtle energies of the universe. The name also symbolizes the purity and clarity of the mind, as the moon is the embodiment of the pure, reflective, and unbiased light. Overall, the name Chandrakant is a source of inspiration and empowerment, reminding one to keep their mind pure, balanced, and connected to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chandrakant: Moon and generous, one who loves to bestow the blessings of the moon's steady and calming influence.

historical_references.reference: Chandrakant was a Maratha warrior and nobleman from the 17th century. He was a close companion and trusted general of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the founder of the Maratha Empire in India.

Chandrakant was a renowned Jain scholar and philosopher from the 12th century. He wrote several works on Jain philosophy and ethics, and is considered one of the most influential Jain thinkers of the medieval period.
